environment.os: Ubuntu 22.04 under WSL; Windows CPU analysis

title: GOOSE ground-category errors across eight scenarios: fresh 24-frame PTv3 subset
dataset: GOOSE 3D base validation, challenge labels v1.1, eight scenarios
sensor_configuration: VLS128 LiDAR; single-scan PTv3 predictions; no radar
annotation_schema: Fine semantic labels remapped to eight challenge classes; sky 8 mapped to other 0 as original loader
split: 24 preselected frames, three interior-quantile frames from each of eight scenarios; not full validation
model: Published challenge PTv3 epoch 33; Pointcept 92f91cc plus documented compatibility patch; FP32, patch64, flash-off, one augmentation
commands: Run Pointcept tools/test.py with exact options in docs/goose-multiscenario-terrain.md

notes: Success means this bounded inference/diagnostic completed. Pooled ground correctness stays high but is dominated by one distant-ground scenario; equal-scenario sensitivity differs. Obstacle-to-ground confusion is dominated by buildings at 100-150m. Points are correlated, not whole objects; no unseen-ground coverage, radar comparison, hole labels or driving safety claim.
